## Problem

What concrete user or maintainer problem does this solve?

## Evidence

Link official sources, retained measurements, issues, or fixture failures. Distinguish verified facts from hypotheses.

## Change

Describe the smallest implemented change and any affected skill/artifact contracts.

## Risk

Cover activation collisions, unsupported claims, media rights, dependencies, security/privacy, browser behavior, accessibility, performance, and compatibility where relevant.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run evals`
- [ ] Browser/motion smoke tests when affected
- [ ] New dependency decision record when affected
- [ ] New media ledger entry when affected
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, copied designs, or unlicensed assets

Paste exact commands and results. Attach viewport-labeled evidence for visual changes.
